paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, compound numbers 287 to 313, continued from the preceding page: the page carries no Tabelle caption, no shared-substituent caption and no scaffold drawing, only the shaded column header row and the rows. Subscripts and superscripts are printed as such (R7a, R7b, R12, R1 with superscript labels; PrSO2, PhSO2, MeSO2, EtSO2, PhC(O)CH2 with subscript digits); they are flattened to plain text here. The cells are chemical symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The L column is CHMe in every row on this page. The R1 column changes value mid-table: rows 287 to 293 are O-c-Hexyl, rows 294 to 313 are O-c-Pentyl. The R12 cells of rows 289 and 313 are printed a little further right than their neighbours; the text is the same PhSO2. A small ink speck sits immediately above the O of O-c-Hexyl in row 288, and fainter specks sit in the Nr. cell of row 288 and the R7a cell of row 307; these are scan artifacts, not characters. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so Bz, Pr, Et and c-Hexyl / c-Pentyl are transcribed as printed and not expanded. The table ends after row 313 and the lower third of the page is blank apart from a single stray speck below the table.
